content.thinking: Oops, gen used `random.sample` (module-level) instead of `rng.sample`, which also made it non-deterministic. Fix.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/approved = random.sample/approved = rng.sample/' tmp/gen.py && sed -i 's/rng.sample(range(len(preds)), size)/rng.sample(range(len(preds)), min(size, len(preds)))/' tmp/gen.py && python3 tmp/difftest.py 1 300 2>&1 | tail -20
